occurrences.snippet: That is, between komal Dhaivata and Madhyama understand the places of two notes at equal distance: the first will be tīvra (sharp) Madhyama and the second the Pañcama note.
Measure the distance from Sa down to Dhaivata, and place tīvra (sharp) Madhyama that same height above Ṛṣabha, and śuddha Gāndhāra in the middle between Sa and tīvra Ma′.
Between tīvra Madhyama and Gāndhāra is śuddha Madhyama; between Ṛṣabha and Ṣaḍja komal Ṛṣabha is held [to lie].
Between tīvra (sharp) Madhyama and Gāndhāra, śuddha Madhyama; and between Ṛṣabha and Ṣaḍja, komal Ṛṣabha: this is the proper placing.
